backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a cloud storage application that composes access control, authorization, blob storage, and user approval mixins, and defines shared types for files, folders, notifications, activity logs, trash, sharing, and favorites.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs and titles to their relevant source files, component dependencies, and test IDs for the admin dashboard restructuring and related features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's React components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'CloudStorage' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes, wraps the app in QueryClient and ThemeProvider, and handles authentication flow including approval checks and profile setup gating.
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: Card component that fetches and displays recent file activities (upload, download, delete) with icons, file names, and relative timestamps in a scrollable list, showing a spinner or empty state as needed.
frontend/src/components/BulkDeleteDialog: Alert dialog for bulk-deleting multiple files, allowing users to select a retention period (30/60/90 days) before moving files to trash.
Dialog for sharing multiple selected files with another user by entering their principal ID and configuring view/edit/download permissions.
Full-screen error UI displayed when the backend connection times out, offering retry and page-refresh actions.
frontend/src/components/CreateFolderDial: Dialog for creating a new folder (or subfolder) by entering a name, using the useCreateFolder mutation and showing toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/DeleteConfirmati: Alert dialog for permanently deleting selected trash items, showing file count and total size with an optional secure-wipe checkbox.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFileDialog: Dialog for moving a single file to trash with a configurable retention period (default 30 days, up to 90 days) before automatic deletion.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderConf: Alert dialog for permanently deleting one or more trashed folders, warning that all contained files and subfolders will also be irreversibly removed.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderDial: A confirmation dialog for moving a folder to trash, using the `useDeleteFolderToTrash` mutation hook and displaying a toast on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderToTr: A dialog for moving a folder to trash with a configurable retention period (30/60/90 days), converting the selected days to nanoseconds before calling the provided `onConfirm` callback.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches rendering errors and displays an alert with retry/refresh options, showing error details in development mode.
frontend/src/components/FileFilterDropdo: A dropdown UI component for filtering files by name, type, date range, and size range, with an active filter count badge and a clear-all option.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: The main file and folder listing component that integrates search, filtering, sorting, pagination, and bulk/individual actions (rename, move, delete, preview, share, favorites) with password-gated folder operations.
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: A full-screen file preview overlay that renders images, videos, PDFs, and text files from a `Uint8Array`, with a download button and close control.
A debounced search input component (300ms delay) with a clear button for filtering files by name or type.
frontend/src/components/FileSortDropdown: A dropdown menu component that allows users to sort files by name, date, size, or type, displaying the current sort field and direction with icons.
frontend/src/components/FileToolbar.tsx: A toolbar component combining search input, filter dropdown, sort dropdown, and grid/list view toggle controls for the file browser interface.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: A drag-and-drop file upload component that supports multiple file selection, shows upload progress, and adds uploaded files to a recent uploads context.
frontend/src/components/FolderActionPass: A dialog that prompts for a folder's password before allowing a specific action, enforcing a 5-attempt lockout stored in sessionStorage using SHA-256 hashing.
frontend/src/components/FolderBreadcrumb: A recursive breadcrumb navigation component that walks up the folder parent chain to render clickable path segments from root to the current folder.
frontend/src/components/FolderPasswordPr: A dialog for entering a password to unlock a protected folder, using SHA-256 hashing and enforcing a session-based lockout after 5 failed attempts.
frontend/src/components/FolderProtection: A modal for managing folder password protection, supporting setting, changing, or removing a password and toggling the folder lock state with current-password verification.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders the app's sticky top navigation bar with logo, search, notification bell with unread badge, dark/light theme toggle, and a user avatar dropdown menu with logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Defines the main page layout composing the Header, Sidebar, and an Outlet for nested routes, wrapped in an ErrorBoundary.
frontend/src/components/LoadingTimeout.t: Wraps children and shows a timeout error UI with a refresh button if the loading state exceeds a configurable threshold (default 45 seconds).
frontend/src/components/MoveFolderDialog: Dialog component that lets users move a folder to a different parent folder or root, filtering out the folder's own descendants and showing a confirmation step before executing the move.
frontend/src/components/MoveToFolderDial: Dialog component that allows users to select a destination folder from a radio list and move one or more files into it using the move mutation.
frontend/src/components/Notifications.ts: Displays a list of user notifications with type-specific icons and text, supports marking notifications as read on click, and handles loading/error/empty states.
frontend/src/components/PaginationContro: Reusable pagination UI component that renders page navigation buttons, ellipsis, first/last page shortcuts, and an items-per-page selector with range info display.
frontend/src/components/PinnedFiles.tsx: Displays a horizontally scrollable list of user-favorited/pinned files with name and size, fetched via useGetFavorites hook, with loading skeletons and error/empty states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Renders a first-time profile setup form collecting display name and optional email, saving via useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation and calling onProfileSaved callback on success.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Provides three quick-action buttons—upload files, create folder, and create a blank text document—wiring file input, upload mutation, and folder dialog together.
frontend/src/components/RecentActivityCa: Shows a list of up to 10 recent file activities (upload, delete, restore, share) with icons and relative timestamps, fetched via useGetRecentActivities hook.
frontend/src/components/RenameFileDialog: Dialog for renaming a file that is UI-complete but currently shows an error toast because the backend rename endpoint is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/components/RenameFolderDial: Dialog that allows renaming an existing folder by calling the useRenameFolder mutation, with inline validation and success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/RestoreDialog.ts: Dialog for restoring one or more trashed files/folders, letting the user choose between restoring to the original location or a custom path.
frontend/src/components/SharedByMe.tsx: Displays a paginated, searchable list of files the current user has shared, with options to revoke individual or bulk shares and permission badges.
frontend/src/components/SharedWithMe.tsx: Displays a paginated, searchable list of files shared with the current user, supporting preview and download actions based on per-file permissions.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Renders the app's collapsible left navigation sidebar with links to main routes and a storage quota indicator at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/SmartSuggestions: Shows a list of AI-driven file suggestions based on access history, fetched via useGetSmartSuggestions, with loading and empty states.
Displays a storage usage card with a color-coded progress bar showing used vs. total quota, fetched via useGetStorageQuota.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: Compact sidebar widget showing a small storage usage progress bar and used/total byte counts, using the same quota query hook.
frontend/src/components/TrashFilters.tsx: Provides filter controls (search, file type, owner, date range, original path) for the trash view, emitting filtered TrashMetadata arrays via a callback.
frontend/src/components/TrashStorageIndi: Displays a card showing how much storage is used by trash, including size and percentage of total quota, with a loading skeleton state.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: Admin component that lists all users' storage usage in a table and allows per-user quota editing and saving in MB.
frontend/src/contexts/RecentUploadsConte: React context that tracks recently uploaded files in memory, providing add and clear operations via a custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileFilters.ts: Hook managing file filter state (name, type, date range, size range) and providing a memoized function to apply those filters to a list of FileMetadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSearch.ts: Hook that maintains a search query string and provides a memoized function to filter FileMetadata by file name or extension.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSorting.ts: Hook managing sort field and order state, providing a memoized function to sort FileMetadata by name, date, size, or type.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication via AuthClient, exposing identity, login/clear functions, and login status through a React context and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/usePagination.ts: Generic pagination hook that tracks current page and items-per-page state, providing a function to slice any data array to the current page.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including file CRUD, folder management, favorites, sharing, trash, notifications, and admin operations. Exports typed query and mutation hooks that wrap the ICP actor methods with cache invalidation logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the UI.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` utility function that merges Tailwind CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only dashboard page that displays user approval management, an administrations table, login logs, and storage management, with actions to approve or reject pending users.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main file manager page that renders a folder breadcrumb navigation, file list, upload area toggle, and a create folder dialog with support for nested folder navigation.
frontend/src/pages/Favorites.tsx: Page that lists the user's starred/favorite files with options to preview, download, and remove favorites, including loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home dashboard overview page displaying storage usage, quick action links, pinned files, recent activity, notifications, and smart suggestions in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login landing page with feature highlights (encryption, access, privacy, speed) and a button to authenticate via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/Recent.tsx: Displays recently uploaded files with search, filter, sort, pagination, bulk selection, preview, download, favorite, and delete capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing users to view account info, configure trash retention period, and toggle the app theme (light/dark/system).
frontend/src/pages/Shared.tsx: Shared files page with two tabs — files shared with the current user and files shared by the current user — rendered via SharedWithMe and SharedByMe components.
frontend/src/pages/Trash.tsx: Trash management page showing deleted files and folders with sorting, filtering, pagination, bulk selection, restore, and permanent delete actions.
frontend/src/pages/WaitingApproval.tsx: Displays a pending-approval screen after login, auto-submits an approval request, and lets the user refresh status or log out while awaiting admin review.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist/retrieve values via sessionStorage and clean sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking the admin dashboard app's existing features (tabbed layout, user/storage/activity management) and pending feature requests, along with architectural notes and known issues.
